title: Computability of Julia sets for complex Hénon maps: The role of attracting and neutral cycles
summary: We study the computability of Julia sets for polynomial diffeomorphisms of $\mathbb{C}^2$ with dynamical degree $d>1$, whose prototypical examples are complex Hénon maps. In previous work, we established computability under the assumption of hyperbolicity (Axiom A). Here, we extend this result to maps whose Fatou components are attracting basins, allowing for the possibility of no attracting basins or infinitely many basins. This yields computability of the Julia set for several classes of non-hyperbolic maps, including certain substantially dissipative maps in the Lyubich-Peters class, and…
